title: Design System: SMMS Workshop Service Monitoring Dashboard

narrative.overview: The visual language is clean, modern, professional, slightly futuristic, and industrial, rejecting dark cyberpunk and neon glows for high-glanceability distance viewing under active facility lighting.
keyCharacteristics: High-contrast charcoal and dark navy typography set against a calm, light neutral ground.
Tri-channel status semantics combining color, semantic SVG iconography, and explicit textual state names.
Decoupled presentation architecture ensuring mock telemetry can transition to live hardware RFID streams without visual redesign.

rules.name: The Tri-Channel Status Rule
rules.body: Status is never communicated by color alone. Every status representation must pair distinct color with an SVG icon and explicit text.

dos: Do maintain high text contrast (>= 4.5:1) across all elements.
Do format numeric times and percentages with tabular-nums.
Do keep summary counts dynamically computed from the active dataset.
donts: Don't use dark-mode neon glows, matrix green, or glassmorphic blurs.
Don't rely on color alone to indicate equipment status.
Don't invent mandatory diagnostic fields such as RFID RSSI or technician names on this surface.
